questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "A community gardener visits our school to help us plan a small green corner. I hand out blank garden plans to every member of the group. She asks us to mark the places that receive light during the day. We learn from her careful method of observing before choosing any plants. Instead of guessing, we visit the corner at different times and make notes. The plans begin to look different from our first drawings full of flowers everywhere. By Friday, we have a modest plan that fits the space we actually have." This supports the answer: "Learning to plan a garden through careful observation".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：一位社区园丁来学校，帮我们规划一个小绿化角。 我给小组每位成员分发空白花园规划图。 她让我们标出白天能晒到光的位置。 我们向她学习先观察、再选植物的细致方法。 我们没有猜测，而是在不同时间去观察，做记录。 这些规划图开始不同于最初到处画满花朵的图画。 到周五，我们有了一个适合实际空间的小规模方案。 因此正确选项为“Learning to plan a garden through careful observation”。

translation.stem: 文章的中心意思是什么？

questions.explanation: The passage says: "I decide to learn paper folding by myself during the long weekend. A library book shows each fold clearly, and I start with an easy boat. My younger brother is building a tower nearby and keeps cheering when it grows. I ask him to keep the noise down because I need to read each step carefully. He moves to the next room, and I thank him for understanding. My first boat leans to one side, so I unfold it and check the picture again. By evening, three little boats stand on my desk, each neater than the last." This supports the answer: "Teaching Myself to Fold a Better Boat".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：长周末里，我决定自己学习折纸。 图书馆借来的书把每一步折法画得很清楚，我先从简单小船做起。 弟弟在附近搭塔，塔一变高就欢呼。 我请他降低声量，因为我要仔细读每一步。 他移到隔壁房间，我感谢他的理解。 第一只船歪向一边，我展开它，重新对照图画。 到晚上，三只小船立在桌上，一只比一只整齐。 因此正确选项为“Teaching Myself to Fold a Better Boat”。

passages.text: A community gardener visits our school to help us plan a small green corner. I hand out blank garden plans to every member of the group. She asks us to mark the places that receive light during the day. We learn from her careful method of observing before choosing any plants. Instead of guessing, we visit the corner at different times and make notes. The plans begin to look different from our first drawings full of flowers everywhere. By Friday, we have a modest plan that fits the space we actually have.

parallelText.en: A community gardener visits our school to help us plan a small green corner.
parallelText.zh: 一位社区园丁来学校，帮我们规划一个小绿化角。

parallelText.en: I hand out blank garden plans to every member of the group.
parallelText.zh: 我给小组每位成员分发空白花园规划图。

parallelText.en: She asks us to mark the places that receive light during the day.
parallelText.zh: 她让我们标出白天能晒到光的位置。

parallelText.en: We learn from her careful method of observing before choosing any plants.
parallelText.zh: 我们向她学习先观察、再选植物的细致方法。

parallelText.en: Instead of guessing, we visit the corner at different times and make notes.
parallelText.zh: 我们没有猜测，而是在不同时间去观察，做记录。

parallelText.en: The plans begin to look different from our first drawings full of flowers everywhere.
parallelText.zh: 这些规划图开始不同于最初到处画满花朵的图画。

parallelText.en: By Friday, we have a modest plan that fits the space we actually have.
parallelText.zh: 到周五，我们有了一个适合实际空间的小规模方案。
